record.description_evidence:
ScrollToStudy – Turn Screen Time into Study Time

Tired of doomscrolling when you should be studying? ScrollToStudy flips the habit: your study material becomes the feed.
One scroll at a time, you actually learn something.

Your study material, reimagined

Upload anything: PDFs, websites, YouTube links, audio recordings, photos of notes, or type it in manually. ScrollToStudy’s AI transforms it into a full learning experience in seconds.

Everything you need, in one place

Personalized Study Feed
Scroll through flashcards, quizzes, and summaries, like a social feed but for your brain.

AI Study Notes
Dense, visual cheat sheets that cover your material completely.

AI Podcast
Listen to your content as a generated audio episode, perfect for learning on the go.

AI Chat
Ask questions about your material and get instant, context-aware answers.

Focus Mode
Block distracting apps with Screen Time while you study.

Multiple Feeds
Create a separate feed for every subject, exam, or topic.

Why students love it

ScrollToStudy blends proven learning techniques like spaced repetition and active recall with an interface that feels familiar and engaging. Studying stops feeling like a chore.

Perfect for students, professionals, and lifelong learners who want to retain more and stay motivated.

Questions or feedback? Reach us at support@scrolltostudy.com

Please note: Some features, including unlimited feed creation, require a Pro subscription.

Introducing brainy, your ultimate app for studying and productivity. Record, upload audio, and take notes. brainy transforms them into transcripts, notes, flashcards, and a Knowledge Base. Learn any concept using AI-generated personalized and interactive content. It also provides insights from documents, audio, and videos with links to the source. It boosts concept memorization with brainy's personalized flashcard feed. 
Ace your studies, assignments, and exams with brainy's learning and productivity features. 

Endorsed by both Microsoft for Startups and Google for Startups Cloud Program, this innovative app is your go-to note-taking tool. Sign up now! 

Key Features:

- PRIVATE AI TUTOR SESSIONS: Experience personalized learning with brainy’s Private AI Tutor Sessions. The AI Tutor engages you in real-time conversations to help you truly understand each topic, actively tracks your progress, and provides step-by-step guidance until you master the material. It also offers clear explanations, answers your questions, and presents key visuals or interactive content to help you learn faster. Unlock your potential with smart, responsive tutoring designed just for you.

- SMART NOTE TAKING & RECORDING: An AI-powered writing assistant that styles and structures the text for better visual appeal and organization, corrects errors, enhances text, and accommodates custom requests.
Record or upload your lectures, meetings, or seminars directly into brainy to let the AI generate transcripts and formatted notes automatically. It is ideal for busy students and professionals on the go! 

- LEARN FASTER WITH AI: Simply enter a topic, question, syllabus or upload PDF files, and choose your expertise level and mode. Our AI will create interactive, personalized content to enrich your learning experience, including generating questions to improve understanding and memorization. With brainy’s Conversational AI Tutor, you can clarify and discuss topics within AI games, making complex concepts easier to grasp. brainy tailors a personalized course and AI tutor feedback makes learning both effective and enjoyable.

- FLASHCARDS FOR ENHANCED MEMORIZATION: Enhance your memory retention and knowledge mastery with brainy's Flashcard Feed, which features an advanced repetition algorithm tailor-made to optimize memorization. brainy links your flashcards to the exact lecture spot where the concepts were discussed, making it easy to study again.

- PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT: brainy's AI insights feature offers seamless productivity enhancement. Just take a picture or upload an image of a question to receive an instant answer. Upload your documents, audio files, and YouTube videos to extract valuable information effortlessly. Gain instant access to answers and references, maximizing your efficiency and task completion with ease.

- POWERFUL KNOWLEDGE BASE: brainy makes studying easy. Just ask your Knowledge Base to receive precise answers and insights quickly. You can even navigate to the exact text in the documents from which answers are derived. If you want to remember it, convert it into a flashcard.


Free perks with every signup:
- A monthly allowance of 300 minutes for audio processing to obtain AI notes and flashcards,
- 100 monthly requests for document insights,
- A free notepad,
- Free unlimited raw transcripts with highlighted transcript sentences as you listen,
- Seamless files, audio & notes access across iPhones & iPads.

Download brainy now!

Subscription Plan:
- Offers 80 monthly hours for recording audio and generating notes and flashcards,
- Provides 1000 monthly requests for document insights,
- Creates a knowledge base that assists you in retrieving answers and insights,
- Offers 1 year of cloud access to recordings, transcripts, notes, & the knowledge base.

The app is designed for English language usage only. Importantly, we respect users' privacy, and the app neither sells user data nor shares it with other users. Period.

record.name: Study AI: Homework Solver
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Study AI is a cutting-edge mobile application that harnesses the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to revolutionize the way you approach scientific tasks. With Study AI, you can simply snap a photo of any complex problem from the fields of algebra, chemistry, physics or other scientific subjects, and let the app do the rest. It's like having a personal tutor in your pocket, available anytime, anywhere. 

Key Features:

Intelligent Photo Analysis: Study AI utilizes advanced AI algorithms to analyze the photo of your scientific task accurately. Whether it's an algebraic equation or a chemical formula, the app can decipher the problem, break it down, and identify the relevant components.

Instant Solutions: Within seconds, Study AI provides you with comprehensive solutions to your scientific problems. The app's AI-powered engine applies complex calculations, rule-based algorithms, and extensive scientific knowledge to generate step-by-step solutions tailored to your specific task.

Detailed Explanations: Understanding the process is just as important as finding the solution. Study AI goes beyond providing answers and offers detailed explanations for each step of the solution. This helps you grasp the underlying concepts and enhances your learning experience.

Comprehensive Subject Coverage: Study AI supports a wide range of scientific subjects, including algebra, calculus, chemistry, physics, and more. No matter the complexity or topic, the app is designed to handle a variety of scientific tasks, making it a versatile tool for students, professionals, and enthusiasts alike.

User-Friendly Interface: Study AI features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, ensuring a seamless experience for users of all skill levels. Its sleek design and easy-to-navigate layout make it effortless to capture photos, view solutions, and explore additional resources.

Please note, some of the features are limited or available only to premium subscription holders. Namely: detailed and step-by-step solutions, unlimited AI queries and ads-free experience.

Privacy and Security: Rest assured that your data and scanned photos are treated with the utmost confidentiality. Study AI prioritizes user privacy and implements robust security measures to protect your information. For more details please see our privacy policy https://telegra.ph/APENGAMES-O%C3%9C-Privacy-Policy-10-20 and Terms of use https://telegra.ph/APENGAMES-O%C3%9C-Terms-of-Use-EULA-06-02

Unlock the power of AI and transform the way you tackle scientific challenges with Study AI. Whether you're a student looking for quick homework help, a professional needing on-the-go problem-solving assistance, or an enthusiast eager to explore scientific concepts, Study AI is the ultimate tool for your academic and scientific journey.

Note: Study AI is intended to assist users in their scientific tasks and learning process. It is always recommended to understand the underlying principles and concepts rather than solely relying on automated solutions.

Math Panda is an AI-powered maths tutor for Year 1 and Year 2. A friendly panda guides pupils through addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division — adapting to each learner's pace and making practice genuinely fun.

How it works
Pupils practise maths through interactive games and quizzes. The AI panda adapts difficulty automatically, so lessons always feel achievable — never too easy, never overwhelming.

- Voice Responses — The panda reads tasks and explanations aloud to support early readers.
- Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication & Division — Full coverage of core primary maths operations.
- Multiplication & Division Tables — Structured, lesson-by-lesson mastery from the 2× table through the 9× table.
- Progress Reports — Detailed analytics so parents and teachers can track skill development over time.
- Multi-Player Support — Works great for siblings or small classroom groups.
- Safe Environment — No chat with strangers, no social features, no external links without parental approval.
- Year-Level Content — Every activity reviewed for educational value.

Learn AI skills you'll actually use - at work and everywhere else! Build real projects from scratch, get properly good at the tools already on your phone, sharpen the skills that make AI worth using, and learn to tell a genuine shortcut from a demo that only works on stage.

AI Skills is a hands-on AI course that fits in your pocket. More than 100 courses and 1,000+ hands-on lessons are waiting for you - each one 5-10 minutes long and ending with something you can use the same day. No jargon, no theory you'll never apply. Learn at your own level and your own pace, in four different ways:

1. Build Something
Finish with a real result you keep: a landing page, a pitch deck, a business plan, a brand identity, a plan for the trip you've been putting off. You don't read about the process - you go through it, step by step, and walk out with the thing itself.

2. Master a Tool
Get properly good at the tools you already open every day: email, calendar, docs, spreadsheets, notes, automations. Most people use maybe a tenth of what these can do. These courses close that gap, one practical task at a time.

3. Learn a Skill
Writing, research, planning, analysis, organizing your own life admin. The skills that don't belong to any single app and don't expire when the next model ships.

4. Think Like a Pro
The judgment part: when AI genuinely helps, when it quietly gets in the way, and how to check what it hands you before you pass it on. No hype and no panic - just an honest read on what these tools do well and where they fall short.

Not sure where to start? Follow a guided path that takes you from complete beginner to confident daily use, in order, without guessing what comes next. Your progress saves automatically, so a lesson on the bus and a lesson before bed add up.

Some days what you need is a deck due tomorrow or a process nobody has time to fix. Other days it's a move, a wedding, a side project, coursework, a household that needs organising, or just wanting to make something for the fun of it. The same skills cover both - and we teach them that way.

Hilokal ist die beste, kostenlose Sprachaustausch- und Sprachlern-App, um ganz einfach das Sprechen mit Muttersprachlern zu üben. Drop-in-Audio-Chatrooms für Sprachschüler zum Reden. Finde jetzt einen Sprachaustauschpartner, Nachhilfelehrer oder einfach neue Freunde!

Triff Freunde und lerne Koreanisch, Englisch, Chinesisch, Japanisch, Spanisch, Portugiesich, Französisch, Deutsch,Tagalog, Indonesisch, Malaysisch, Hindi und mehr. 

Steiger dein Sprachniveau von Anfänger zu Mittelstufe bis hin zu fortgeschritten. Erreiche fließende Sprachkenntnisse spielerisch gemeinsam mit anderen. Konzentriere dich auf das Sprechen, und lerne nebenbei auch Aussprache, Schreiben, Hörverständnis, Grammatik und vieles mehr.

WARUM HILOKAL?

 Audio Chaträume - einfach zu bedienen.
Hilokal ist die erste mobile App, die sich auf Drop-in-Audio für Sprachlernende konzentriert. Somit kannst du dich jederzeit und überall mit Muttersprachlern deiner Zielsprache treffen und austauschen. Mach dir keine Gedanken über Terminplanung! Alle unsere Funktionen sind so gestaltet, dass sie Sprachschülern beim Sprechen helfen.

 Es macht Spaß, ist einfach und macht süchtig!
Wir lernen, indem wir mit Muttersprachlern und Freunden sprechen! Mit dieser App macht das Sprechen Ihrer Zielsprache SPASS und ist gleichzeitig sozial. Koreanische Freunde oder Freunde in deiner Zielsprache zu finden, ist eine großartige Möglichkeit, Sprachgewohnheiten zu entwickeln. Du wirst stundenlang üben. 

 Kostenloser Sprachunterricht mit Tutoren!
Wir konzentrieren uns momentan auf Koreanisch und Englisch, aber es kommen täglich mehr Sprachlehrer hinzu. Professionelle koreanische Lehrpersonen geben kostenlosen Gruppenunterricht, um beim Erlernen der Sprache zu helfen. Auch 1:1 Stunden sind möglich.

Andere Sprachaustausch-Apps haben Textkorrekturen, Hilokal hat Sprachkorrekturen, damit du deine Sprechfertigkeit und Aussprache verbessern kannst. Speicher Sprachnotizen, erhalte Korrekturen und werde besser! So kannst du deine Aussprache optimieren und fließend sprechen.

Diese App konzentriert sich auf das Sprechen deiner Zielsprache, deshalb haben wir eine Untertitel-Funktion, mit der du die Untertitel deines Sprachpartners sehen kannst, während er spricht! Das Verstehen von echten Muttersprachlern ist einfach und macht Spaß.

Dies ist eine unterhaltsame und soziale Sprachaustausch-App, die dich ganz einfach mit Muttersprachlern vernetzt.

Audio-Voice-Chats sind eine gute Möglichkeit, deine Sprachlern-Community zu finden und deine Zielsprache endlich fließend zu sprechen.

record.name: AI English Tutor - SpeakLab
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
SpeakLab AI is an advanced AI-powered language learning app designed to help you improve your English speaking skills through real conversation and personalised practice.

Unlike traditional language learning apps that mainly focus on memorising vocabulary and grammar rules, SpeakLab AI is built around speaking. The goal is to help you become comfortable using English naturally in real-life situations.

With SpeakLab AI, you can practise interactive conversations with intelligent AI tutors that respond in real time. You can speak freely while the app analyses your pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, fluency, and clarity. After every conversation, you receive instant feedback to help you understand what you did well and what you can improve.

One of the most powerful features of SpeakLab AI is pronunciation analysis.

As you speak, SpeakLab AI listens to your pronunciation and gives instant feedback on how clearly and accurately you are speaking. The app can detect mispronounced words, incorrect sounds, missing stress, unnatural rhythm, and unclear pronunciation. You immediately see which words need improvement and receive guidance on how to say them more naturally.

You can practise individual words, complete sentences, or full conversations. After each exercise, SpeakLab AI gives you a pronunciation score and highlights specific areas for improvement. This helps you sound clearer, more natural, and more confident over time.

SpeakLab AI analyses:

• Pronunciation accuracy
• Speaking fluency
• Grammar mistakes
• Vocabulary usage
• Sentence clarity
• Natural speaking rhythm

SpeakLab AI is ideal for:

• Beginners who want to start speaking English from zero
• Intermediate learners who want to speak more naturally and fluently
• Advanced learners who want to improve pronunciation and confidence
• Students preparing for TOEFL, IELTS, and speaking exams
• Professionals who need English for work, meetings, and interviews
• Travellers who want to communicate more comfortably abroad

Inside the app, you can practise real-life conversations such as:

• Introducing yourself
• Ordering food or coffee
• Shopping and travelling
• Job interviews
• Work meetings and presentations
• Daily conversations and small talk

SpeakLab AI also helps you improve grammar naturally through conversation. As you speak, the app notices grammar mistakes and explains how to correct them. Vocabulary learning is integrated into every session, helping you learn useful words and expressions for travel, work, daily life, school, and business.

Users often say:

• “I finally feel comfortable speaking English.”
• “The pronunciation feedback helped me improve much faster.”
• “It feels like talking to a real tutor.”
• “The conversations are much more realistic than other language apps.”

The app includes:

• Real-time conversation practice with AI tutors
• Instant feedback on pronunciation, grammar, fluency, and vocabulary
• Pronunciation scoring and live corrections
• Grammar improvement through speaking exercises
• Topic-based vocabulary and conversation lessons
• TOEFL and IELTS speaking practice
• Personalised learning adapted to your level
• Progress tracking and speaking insights

Subscription Information

A subscription is required to access lessons, AI speaking sessions, pronunciation scoring, detailed feedback, and premium conversation modules.

Premium includes:

• Unlimited AI conversations
• Full access to all lessons and speaking topics
• Pronunciation scoring and speaking analysis

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Payment will be charged to your App Store account. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://bugai.company/privacy
Terms of Use: https://bugai.company/terms
